name: markdown
title: Markdown
description: shadcn's apps/v4/components/markdown.tsx (Streamdown with Code Block), with its import paths updated to the project, as the AI Elements install steps direct, and one addition: a link to the page's own origin (relative, a fragment, or the same origin) is a plain link that opens in the same tab, so Streamdown's link safety asks only before a link to another site. Its css adds the @source line Streamdown's README requires, so Tailwind sees its classes.
